decisions.reason: No additional Event is needed because the existing message-53 MODIFY already records the solenoid mechanism, button-controlled actuation, and pre-dispense isolation required by the source decision.
The candidate already records the same-message acceptance of custom render-matched spouts, and the froth-preservation method does not otherwise change its geometry or orientation state.
The existing message-53 MODIFY already captures the exception for custom-fabricated dispensing spouts; the source flow decision requires no further component-strategy change.
Keeping matcha out of the dispensing path until activation does not modify the existing no-drip, sealing, or leak-containment requirements.
The source decision concerns pre-dispense isolation and froth preservation, not the existing requirement that the spout be removable or easy to flush and clean.
The dispensing-path control decision does not change bowl capacity, bowl form, refill acceptability, or capacity-selection priorities.
Preserving froth during dispensing does not alter the independently stated requirement to produce well-mixed matcha with consistent foam.
The source decision adds dispensing controls but does not necessarily change the candidate's compactness, side-profile, or bowl-well constraints.
Adding an electrically actuated dispensing mechanism does not change the selected 120V wall-power source, disabled V1 battery option, or power-architecture priority.
The dispensing-path isolation method does not change whisk size, style, powder compatibility, or bowl compatibility.
The candidate already records the same-message acceptance of stainless-steel custom spouts, and the source flow-quality change requires no additional material update.
The placard text and customer-facing placement are separate clauses in the source message and are unaffected by the dispensing-flow decision.
